Reproducible pure-Python finite arithmetic replays every crucial rank, with complete finite simplex enumeration.

value.rationale: The order-23 primary torsion in the canonical Paley 23 tournament is exceptional in the full 23-vertex doubly regular census. Determining its nontrivial order-11 affine character is a natural, sharply specified equivariant invariant that the nonequivariant Moore-space type does not determine; it distinguishes faithful symmetry action from a trivial torsion class and supplies reusable information for equivariant/Bockstein analyses.
